Switch OFF restores the weekly-close rule exactly (blocker-proven).

Cap, flags, exits untouched.
decision_record_2a.transfer: Each flagged name is a 1%-of-slice position held 91 days; the transfer is the position itself, sized on a price the market no longer offers.
